title: § 301-10.421 How much will my agency reimburse me for a tip to a taxi, TNC, innovative mobility technology company, shuttle service, courtesy transportation driver, or valet parking attendant?

before.text:
§ 301-10.421 How much will my agency reimburse me for a tip to a taxi, shuttle service, courtesy transportation driver, or valet parking attendant?

Link to an amendment published at 82 FR 604, Jan. 5, 2018.

An amount which your agency determines to be reasonable.
